metadata.title: The Last Sweetness of Confevale
metadata.premise: The confectionery Kingdom of Confevale has no heir since the death of Sovereign Praline the First, and a debt owed to the Bitter Concord can only be paid by melting down the Sugar Heart that keeps the realm's magic alive. Three claimants scramble for the throne while a hidden traitor moves to sell the kingdom out from under them.
metadata.narrationVoice: A wry, bittersweet chronicler who savors irony and never flinches from the cost of power

contentLimits.note: All claimants and stakes are adults; no children appear in threatened or harmed roles.

beats.title: The Sugar-Spun Court
beats.prose: Candoria's spires of spun glass sugar catch the grey mourning light. Sovereign Praline the First is three days dead, and the court hums with three rival claims to his throne: Guildmistress Caramella Vex, Steward Marzipan Lyre, and the Concord-favored Baron Thorn Nougat. Somewhere in the ledgers of this dying kingdom lies a debt no one wants to name aloud.
beats.readAloud: The palace smells of burnt caramel and old grief. Courtiers whisper of a debt owed to the Bitter Concord — one that may cost the realm its very sweetness.

options.label: Seek out Guildmistress Caramella Vex in the guild quarter
Seek out Steward Marzipan Lyre at the Sugar Vault
Seek out Baron Thorn Nougat at the Concord embassy

beats.title: The Guildmistress's Ledger
beats.prose: Caramella Vex rules the confectioners' guild with sticky-fingered pragmatism. She offers you spiced wine and a claim to legitimacy built on the labor of thousands of candy-crafters, if you'll back her.
beats.readAloud: "The throne belongs to whoever can keep the ovens burning," Caramella says, licking sugar from her thumb. "Not to whoever holds the oldest name."

options.label: Pledge your support to Caramella's claim
Press her about the treaty debt to the Bitter Concord
Offer no commitment and withdraw

beats.title: The Steward's Vigil
beats.prose: Marzipan Lyre, the dead sovereign's estranged twin, keeps a lonely watch over the Sugar Vault. Their claim is blood-old and bitter with grief, and they seem to know more about the treaty than they say.
beats.readAloud: "I did not want this crown," Marzipan says, staring at the Vault's crystalline door. "I want the kingdom to still exist to wear it."

options.label: Pledge your support to Marzipan's claim
Press them about the treaty debt to the Bitter Concord
Offer no commitment and withdraw

beats.title: The Baron's Sweet Words
beats.prose: Baron Thorn Nougat entertains you in the Concord embassy, all charm and salt-crystal jewelry. He speaks of stability, of a firm hand, of an end to the realm's soft indecision — and never quite answers what the Concord wants in return.
beats.readAloud: "The Concord only wants what was promised," Thorn says smoothly. "I merely intend to be the one who delivers it."

options.label: Pledge your support to Thorn's claim
Press him about the treaty debt to the Bitter Concord
Offer no commitment and withdraw

beats.title: Rumors Like Spun Sugar
beats.prose: Every conversation in Candoria circles the same unspoken fact: the Bitter Concord's debt is due, and paying it honestly means surrendering the Sugar Heart, the relic that keeps the kingdom's magic — and its people — from crumbling to inert candy.
beats.readAloud: The court's laughter has a hollow ring now, like a sugar shell over a rotten center.

options.label: Go decipher the Vault's warded ledger yourself
Corner the Concord's junior envoys for answers
Use what you've already learned to force the truth into the open

beats.title: The Warded Ledger
beats.prose: The Sugar Vault's ledger is sealed in crystallized syrup, its true terms hidden beneath decorative glyphs. Somewhere in its fine print is the truth of who forged the debt's final clause.
beats.readAloud: The ledger's glyphs shimmer and rearrange themselves whenever you look away, as if the Vault itself resents being read.

options.label: Carefully decode the ledger's sugar-glyphs
Bribe the vault archivist for the plain translation
Force the Vault open and take the ledger by hand

beats.title: The Vault's Animated Guard
beats.prose: Suits of candied armor, animated by old wardings, clatter to life around the ledger chamber, sugar-glass blades gleaming.
beats.readAloud: The armor's joints creak like breaking toffee as it raises a gleaming blade in your direction.

beats.title: The Forged Clause
beats.prose: The truth is uglier than rumor: Baron Thorn Nougat forged the treaty's final clause, arranging to personally deliver the Sugar Heart to the Concord and seize the throne under their backing — leaving Confevale's people to crumble into ordinary, mortal candy while he profits from the ruins.
beats.readAloud: There, in Thorn's own hand disguised as the sovereign's: a signature that damns him, and a kingdom's fate signed away in spiced ink.

options.label: Confront Baron Thorn Nougat with what you know
Rally the surviving claimants to stand against Thorn
Seek the Concord envoy to renegotiate the debt directly

beats.title: Showdown at the Embassy
beats.prose: Thorn Nougat drops all pretense of charm the moment you lay the forged clause before him. His mercenaries, paid in Concord salt, move to silence the accusation.
beats.readAloud: "You should have taken a sweeter bargain," Thorn says, backing toward the door as his enforcers draw steel.

beats.title: A Fragile Alliance
beats.prose: Whatever allies you've won must be called upon now, if the throne — and the kingdom — is to be saved from Thorn's forged bargain.
beats.readAloud: Old rivals clasp hands across a banquet table littered with half-eaten sugar crowns, united only by a common enemy.

options.label: Call upon Guildmistress Caramella's workers
Call upon Steward Marzipan's loyal guard
Face the reckoning with only your own resolve

beats.title: Terms with the Bitter Concord
beats.prose: The Concord's envoy receives you in a hall of salt-frosted glass, unmoved by sentiment, interested only in whether the debt will be paid — and by whom.
beats.readAloud: "A treaty is a treaty," the envoy says, tasting a crystal of salt from a velvet pouch. "Sentiment does not settle debts."

options.label: Offer the Concord envoy a renegotiated treaty
Reveal the Vault's hidden leverage against the Concord
Threaten the envoy with exposing Thorn's forgery publicly

beats.title: The Sugar Heart's Reckoning
beats.prose: With the truth laid bare and Thorn's scheme unraveling, the fate of Confevale rests on a final choice: how the debt is truly paid, and what kind of kingdom rises from the reckoning.
beats.readAloud: The Sugar Heart pulses faintly on its plinth, warm as a living thing, waiting to know its fate.

options.label: Choose mercy: spare Thorn, and reform the realm together
Choose ruthlessness: execute Thorn, and crown your ally absolute
Choose sacrifice: pour your own essence into the Sugar Heart to pay the debt yourself

beats.title: A Kinder Sugar Kingdom
beats.prose: Thorn is stripped of title and exiled rather than executed; the Concord debt is renegotiated into decades of fair trade instead of a single ruinous payment. Confevale survives, softer and wiser, its new ruler bound by mercy rather than fear.
beats.readAloud: The Sugar Heart dims to a gentle glow, no longer straining under an impossible debt. Candoria's bells ring out, cautiously hopeful.

beats.title: The Crown of Salt and Sugar
beats.prose: Thorn is executed for treason before the assembled court, and your chosen ally is crowned with absolute authority, the Concord cowed by the display of resolve. Confevale endures, but its new sovereign rules through fear as much as sweetness.
beats.readAloud: The new crown gleams, hard-edged as rock candy, as the court bows low and says nothing of what was lost to earn it.

beats.title: The Debt Paid in Full
beats.prose: You offer your own vitality to the Sugar Heart, becoming a living anchor for the kingdom's magic in place of the relic the Concord demanded. Confevale is saved, whole and unbroken — but you will never again be quite as you were, bound now to the realm's sweetness forever.
beats.readAloud: Warmth floods through you and out into every spire of Candoria, and for the first time in weeks, the whole city tastes faintly, impossibly, of hope.

beats.title: The Kingdom Crumbles
beats.prose: Thorn's enforcers overwhelm you before the truth can be made to matter. In the weeks that follow, the Baron delivers the Sugar Heart to the Concord himself, and Confevale's magic guttecrs out. The spires dull to grey, ordinary candy, and the kingdom's story ends not with a bang but with a slow, sad sweetness fading from the world.
beats.readAloud: The last spun-glass spire dims and cracks in the cold morning air, and no one is left with the power to stop it.

victory.description: Reach the ledger chamber and escape with the treaty scroll before the guardians can pin the party down.
